title: The Koi Pond: A Strongly Lensed Protocluster Core hosting a Diverse Population of DSFGs
summary: We present James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) observations of PJ0846+15, \textit{The Koi Pond}, a strongly lensed protocluster core at Cosmic Noon. This field offers a magnified view of 11 dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) all at $z=2.67$ (within $ΔV=800$ km s$^{-1}$) spanning a projected extent of $>300$ kpc lensed by a $z=0.77$ foreground cluster. NIRCam and ALMA Band 6 continuum measurements map the stellar distribution and thermal dust emission respectively at a spatial resolution of $\sim$0.15$^{\prime\prime}$. This analysis reveals a diverse population of DSFGs, with evidence of both interacting and non-interacting systems exhibiting a wide range of morphological features including spiral arms, bars, bulges, clumps/stellar clusters, tidal tails/debris and displaced molecular gas reservoirs. Comparing the rest-frame J- band continuum (F444W) vs (i-J) color (F277W$-$F444W), we find a wide range of values, suggesting a $>$1-dex spread in stellar mass and a dust attenuation reddening of $ΔA_{\mathrm{V}} > 1$ mag. The DSFG members exhibit varying dust sizes relative to the stellar emission, ranging from compact dusty cores to galaxy-wide emission. Resolved color maps of individual sources showing a spread as high as F277W$-$F444W$=2$ mag suggesting complex stellar-to-dust geometry. Although gas-rich mergers are identified in the core, the most red and dust emitting members are disks exhibiting clumpy structure indicating secular growth can drive these starburst events. Such a remarkable range in properties within this sample suggest DSFGs in protocluster core environments follow diverse evolutionary pathways towards their transition into quiescent, elliptical cluster galaxies.

title: ALMA observations of pre-JWST z ~ 10 galaxy candidates: A CO(J = 9-8) line from a ULIRG at z = 2.54 and revisit of the photometric redshifts with JWST photometry
comment: 15 pages, 12 figures (7 in Appendices), MNRAS in press
summary: We present Atacama Large Millimetre/submillimetre Array (ALMA) observations targeting the [OIII]$88\,μ$m line for six $z\sim10$ galaxy candidates selected with the Hubble Space Telescope and the Spitzer Space Telescope. We detect a line ($4.5σ$) and dust continuum emission ($30σ$) in UDS_18697, while detecting neither robust line nor continuum emission in the remaining five objects. The detected line in UDS_18697 is identified as CO($J=9-8$), because follow-up James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) NIRSpec observations have confirmed the redshift as $z=2.54$. UDS_18697 is classified as an ultra luminous infrared galaxy (ULIRG) with far-infrared (FIR) luminosity of $L_\mathrm{FIR}\approx1.1\times10^{12}\,L_\odot$, assuming a dust temperature of $T_\mathrm{d}\approx42\,$K, estimated using a physically-motivated method. We find that UDS_18697 follows the $L_\mathrm{FIR}-L'_\mathrm{CO}$ relation for local and $z>2$ galaxies, albeit being slightly brighter in CO($J=9-8$). Also, based on the follow-up NIRSpec observations and spectral energy distribution fitting using JWST/NIRCam photometry, we found that most of our targets are suggested to be low-$z$ interlopers. Motivated by these redshift misclassifications, we investigate colour--colour selection criteria for high-$z$ galaxies using JWST spectroscopic survey catalogues. We find that elevating a colour threshold tracing the Lyman break is crucial for constructing a robust high-$z$ sample, particularly for wide field surveys such as Euclid Deep Fields and Roman High-Latitude Wide-Area Survey.

title: JWST Whirlpool Galaxy Treasury: Mid-Infrared Emission in M51 and its Relation to Gas Column and Star Formation
summary: Using JWST/MIRI imaging of M51 in eight broadband filters, we investigate correlations of mid-infrared emission from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and dust continuum with molecular, atomic, and ionized gas traced by CO(1-0), HI, and Pa-alpha, respectively. In molecular gas-dominated regions, PAH-dominated filters (F560W, F770W, F1130W, F1280W) exhibit near-linear correlations with CO(1-0) at 40 pc scale, indicating that PAHs are well-mixed with gas and experience relatively constant radiation field intensities. The F1500W, F1800W, and F2100W dust continuum-dominated filters show shallower slopes with CO(1-0), reflecting contributions from star-forming regions with high radiation field intensities. This is reinforced by the near-linear scaling between F2100W and Pa-alpha. PAH-dominated bands do not show this linear trend with Pa-alpha, likely due to their destruction in ionized regions. F1000W behaves similarly to PAH bands in its correlations with CO(1-0) and Pa-alpha. Modeling mid-infrared emission with an empirical decomposition into gas- and star-formation-associated components shows that PAH-dominated filters receive comparable contributions from both, while the relative contribution associated with the Pa-alpha template increases toward longer wavelengths, reaching $\sim$75% in F2100W. These results demonstrate that mid-infrared simultaneously traces the gas column and star formation, but with a systematic wavelength-dependent shift in what drives the correlations: PAHs being more gas-tracing and dust-continuum reflecting star formation. Lastly, considering both HI and H$_2$ at 440 pc resolution, we find a tight, linear relation between $Σ_{HI+H_2}$ and PAH-dominated filters. Although most of our coverage is in H$_2$-dominated regions, we note similar observations with HI, suggesting that PAHs are also well-mixed with atomic gas.

title: OH Line Detections in Southern Galaxies of the IRAS Revised Bright Galaxy Sample
summary: We present a systematic study of OH main-line emission and absorption in 186 southern galaxies from the IRAS Revised Bright Galaxy Sample, using archival MeerKAT snapshot data. OH features are detected in 38 galaxies, including eight with OH maser emission (three new) and 30 showing OH absorption, mostly unreported previously. Four absorption systems exhibit weak OH emission superposed on strong absorption. OH-emitting regions are generally more compact than the associated radio continuum. Most absorption profiles are well fit by two Gaussian components (1667 and 1665 MHz), with an average integrated line ratio of $\sim$1.5. LIRGs show an OH emission detection rate of ~13\%, versus significantly lower rates in non-LIRGs. For sources with radio continuum flux densities >20 mJy, OH absorption detection rates reach ~36\% (LIRGs) and ~27\% (non-LIRGs), while no OH absorption features were detected among sources with lower radio continuum flux densities. This suggests that sufficient background continuum is likely an important factor for the detection of OH absorption. Detected OH emitters follow the empirical $L_{\rm OH}$--$L_{\rm FIR}$ relation, consistent with far-infrared pumping, while non-detections show upper limits below the relation. No significant differences are found between OH absorbers and non-detections in infrared luminosity or radio continuum compactness. Stacked spectra of non-detections reveal no significant OH features, suggesting that sensitivity and orientation alone do not fully explain the absence of absorption. In contrast, mid-infrared colors (e.g., W2--W3) and q_TIR differ between the two populations. OH absorption galaxies occupy an intermediate regime in L_HCN/L_CO between OH megamasers and non-detections, implying that OH absorption detectability is linked to dense molecular gas conditions, with extreme star formation potentially suppressing its occurrence.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用档案MeerKAT快照数据，对IRAS修订亮星系样本中的186个南天星系进行了OH主线发射和吸收的系统研究。在38个星系中探测到OH特征，其中8个具有OH脉泽发射（3个为新发现），30个显示OH吸收，且大多数此前未被报道。四个吸收系统在强吸收上叠加了微弱的OH发射。OH发射区域通常比相关的射电连续谱更紧凑。大多数吸收谱线可以用两个高斯分量（1667和1665 MHz）很好地拟合，平均积分线比约为$\sim$1.5。LIRG的OH发射探测率约为13%，远高于非LIRG。对于射电连续谱流量密度大于20 mJy的源，OH吸收探测率分别达到约36%（LIRG）和约27%（非LIRG），而在射电连续谱流量密度较低的源中未探测到OH吸收特征。这表明足够的背景连续谱可能是探测OH吸收的重要因素。探测到的OH发射源遵循经验性的$L_{\rm OH}$--$L_{\rm FIR}$关系，与远红外抽运一致，而未探测到的源显示出低于该关系的上限。在红外光度或射电连续谱致密性方面，OH吸收源与非探测源之间没有显著差异。非探测源的叠加光谱未显示显著的OH特征，表明仅灵敏度和取向并不能完全解释吸收缺失的原因。相比之下，中红外颜色（如W2--W3）和q_TIR在两个群体之间存在差异。OH吸收星系在L_HCN/L_CO中占据OH巨脉泽和非探测源之间的中间区域，表明OH吸收的可探测性与致密分子气体条件相关，而极端恒星形成可能抑制其出现。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的结论：背景射电连续谱强度是OH吸收探测的重要条件；OH吸收的可探测性与致密分子气体状态相关，而极端恒星形成可能抑制其出现；仅灵敏度和取向不足以解释部分星系OH吸收缺失。

title: Observing Co-Located Neutral and Ionized Gas-Phase Iron Depletion in the Magellanic Clouds
summary: Depletion is the observed phenomenon where gas-phase elemental abundances are reduced through accretion onto dust grains. We measure neutral gas-phase elemental abundances (S, Fe) in the Magellanic Clouds along 33 sightlines using high-resolution UV spectroscopy (HST/COS and HST/STIS), and compare them to ionized gas-phase abundances (S, Fe) adopted from the literature for six co-located H\,\textsc{ii} regions (with the furthest separation of $\lesssim3'$, 50 pc). Comparing S abundances show that S is minimally depleted in the H\,\textsc{ii} regions and surrounding diffuse ISM. However, we find that the gas-phase Fe abundances in H\,\textsc{ii} regions can be lower than those of the neighboring neutral ISM by 0.3 to 2 dex. This difference is likely an offset in the amount of Fe depleted into dust grains. As accretion of gas-phase Fe is likely not effective at the temperatures of the H\,\textsc{ii} regions, Fe depletion into solid form would have occurred in the dense atomic or molecular clouds prior to star formation. Stronger depletion in the H\,\textsc{ii} regions shows that Fe-bearing grains survive destruction in the first few million years following ionization. Our observations highlight that Fe depletion in H\,\textsc{ii} regions can be a useful tracer of Fe depletion in dense molecular clouds, which are challenging to observe directly via UV absorption.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用HST/COS和STIS高分辨率紫外光谱，测量了麦哲伦云33条视线方向上中性气体的S和Fe元素丰度，并与文献中6个共置H II区的电离气体元素丰度进行对比。结果显示S在H II区和弥散星际介质中均几乎不亏损，但H II区的Fe丰度比相邻中性星际介质低0.3到2个数量级，表明H II区中的Fe尘粒在电离后前几百万年内能幸存下来不被破坏。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 耗损是观测到的现象，即气相元素丰度通过吸积到尘埃颗粒上而降低。我们利用高分辨率紫外光谱（HST/COS 和 HST/STIS）沿 33 条视线测量了麦哲伦云中的中性气相元素丰度（S、Fe），并将其与文献中采用的六个共位 H\,\textsc{ii} 区（最大间隔 $\lesssim3'$，50 pc）的电离气相丰度（S、Fe）进行比较。比较 S 丰度表明，S 在 H\,\textsc{ii} 区和周围的弥散星际介质中耗损极小。然而，我们发现 H\,\textsc{ii} 区中的气相 Fe 丰度可能比邻近的中性星际介质低 0.3 到 2 dex。这种差异可能是 Fe 耗损到尘埃颗粒中的量存在偏移。由于在 H\,\textsc{ii} 区的温度下，气相 Fe 的吸积可能并不有效，因此 Fe 在恒星形成之前就已致密原子云或分子云中固化成固态形式。H\,\textsc{ii} 区中更强的耗损表明，含 Fe 尘埃颗粒在电离后的最初几百万年内能够幸存于破坏过程。我们的观测强调，H\,\textsc{ii} 区中的 Fe 耗损可以作为致密分子云中 Fe 耗损的有效示踪剂，而这些致密分子云难以通过紫外吸收直接观测。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，结论为：H II区中的Fe耗损可作为致密分子云中Fe耗损的有效示踪剂，而这些致密分子云难以通过UV吸收直接观测。

title: Why is GN-z11 Bright, Compact, and Nitrogen Enhanced? Insights from UV Absorption and Emission Diagnostics
summary: We investigate the UV spectrum of GN-z11, a luminous, compact galaxy with strong nitrogen lines, at $z=10.60$, using deep JWST/NIRSpec high-resolution IFU and medium-resolution MSA spectra assembled from the JADES, SPURS, and GO programs. After optimized reduction and extraction of the IFU data including an evaluation of statistical and systematic uncertainties, we obtain mutually consistent spectra from the high- and medium-resolution observations. After carefully accounting for the data quality limitations, we identify prominent P-Cygni profiles in NV$λ\lambda1238,1243$, SiIV$λ\lambda1394,1403$, and CIV$λ\lambda1548,1550$, together with broad NIV]$λ\lambda1483,1486$ emission (FWHM $\sim1600$ km s$^{-1}$). The P-Cygni profiles resemble those of massive stars such as O-type stars and luminous blue variables (LBVs), while the broad NIV] emission resembles that of nitrogen-sequence Wolf-Rayet (WN) stars. We fit stellar and active galactic nuclei (AGN) UV spectral models and find that the stellar models are strongly preferred over the AGN models ($Δ$WAIC $=-25$), with the preference driven primarily by the NV P-Cygni profile. These results indicate that the luminous, compact UV continuum of GN-z11 is dominated by massive stars. We derive electron densities from CIII]$λ\lambda1907,1909$, NIII]$λ\lambda1747-1754$, and NIV], with the nitrogen diagnostics extending well beyond the CIII]-based limit and reaching densities of $\gtrsim10^{6.5}$ cm$^{-3}$ for NIV], indicating physically distinct carbon- and nitrogen-emitting nebular components. These findings suggest that the apparent nitrogen enhancement inferred for GN-z11 as a whole may arise when strong narrow nitrogen emission originates from dense gas locally enriched in nitrogen by WN stellar winds and photoionized by nearby massive stars within the same star-forming region.

title: Halo Mass of ULIRGs at Cosmic Noon
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal
summary: We present a clustering analysis of $\sim 3000$ ultraluminous infrared galaxies (ULIRGs) at $z\sim 2$, uniformly selected by $24μ{\rm m}$ flux and IRAC colors in the COSMOS and BOOTES fields. We measure the angular correlation functions of ULIRGs in both fields and fit them with galaxy clustering models. Linear theory modeling shows that these ULIRGs reside in dark matter halos with characteristic masses of $\log M_{\rm h} /({h^{-1}\rm M_{\odot}}) = 12.64\pm 0.50$ in COSMOS and $12.72\pm 0.13$ in BOOTES. The halo occupation distribution (HOD) modeling yields occupation-weighted effective halo masses of $\log M_{\rm eff} /({h^{-1}\rm M_{\odot}}) =12.50^{+0.26}_{-0.28}$ for COSMOS and $12.89^{+0.11}_{-0.12}$ for BOOTES. These host halos are expected to evolve into halos with masses of $\sim 10^{13.6-13.9}\ {h^{-1}\rm M_{\odot}}$ at $z=0$. The HOD fits allow for a non-negligible satellite contribution to the clustering of galaxies in the BOOTES field, but the satellite fraction derived in the COSMOS field appears nearly zero.

AI.tldr: 本文对红移约2处约3000个极亮红外星系（ULIRGs）进行了聚类分析，通过24μm流量与IRAC颜色在COSMOS和BOOTES两个天区中均匀选取样本，测量角相关函数并用星系聚类模型拟合。结果表明这些ULIRGs存在于特征质量约10^12.6-12.7 h^-1 M☉的暗物质晕中，预计在z=0时演化成质量约10^13.6-13.9 h^-1 M☉的晕。HOD拟合显示BOOTES天区存在不可忽略的卫星星系贡献，而COSMOS天区的卫星比例几乎为零。
AI.motivation: 理解z~2时期ULIRGs所处的暗物质晕环境及其质量，从而揭示高红移极端恒星形成星系与暗物质晕之间的大尺度结构关系。
AI.method: 利用COSMOS和BOOTES两个天区的24μm流量和IRAC颜色选择约3000个z~2的ULIRG样本，测量各自天区的角相关函数，并采用线性理论和晕占据分布（HOD）两种模型进行聚类拟合。
AI.result: 线性理论给出特征暗物质晕质量log Mh=12.64±0.50（COSMOS）和12.72±0.13（BOOTES）；HOD建模给出有效晕质量log Meff=12.50（COSMOS）和12.89（BOOTES）。这些晕将在z=0时演化为质量约10^13.6-13.9 h^-1 M☉的暗物质晕。此外，BOOTES天区显示有不可忽略的卫星星系贡献，而COSMOS天区卫星比例几乎为零。
AI.conclusion: z~2的ULIRGs主要居住在大质量暗物质晕中，对应的z=0后代晕约为星系团尺度（10^13.6-13.9 h^-1 M☉），表明这些系统是宇宙早期极端恒星形成活动的显著示踪物，且不同天区卫星成分的差异可能反映了大尺度环境对ULIRG聚集特性的影响。

title: Energy Partitioning in Dust-catalyzed $\mathrm{H_2}$ and HD Formation Revealed by Molecular Simulations Considering Nuclear Quantum Effects
summary: Molecular hydrogen formation on interstellar dust grains is a key surface process in the interstellar medium, but the redistribution of the recombination energy between the substrate and the nascent molecule remains poorly understood. Here, we use ring-polymer molecular dynamics (RPMD) with a machine-learning force field to investigate energy partitioning during $\mathrm{H_2}$ and $\mathrm{HD}$ formation on graphene at $T=25, 50$ and $100 \mathrm{K}$. We focus on the chemisorbed-H recombination pathway previously identified as the dominant low-temperature channel on bare graphitic surfaces when nuclear quantum effects are included. The desorbing molecule retains the major fraction of the effective surface-mediated released energy, while graphene absorbs a smaller but non-negligible part. This molecular retention fraction is nearly temperature-independent over the investigated range. In contrast, the post-formation molecular kinetic-energy distribution changes more strongly with temperature: rovibrational motion dominates at low temperature, whereas center-of-mass translation becomes increasingly important at $100 \mathrm{K}$. $\mathrm{H_2}$ and $\mathrm{HD}$ exhibit broadly similar total energy retention, with only modest isotope-dependent differences in their internal kinetic-energy partitioning. These results provide an energy-resolved microscopic picture of surface-mediated energy redistribution in $\mathrm{H_2}$/$\mathrm{HD}$ formation, with implications for formation-pumping signatures in high-excitation $\mathrm{H_2}$ lines, vibrationally excited $\mathrm{H_2}$ chemistry, and collisional excitation of coexisting molecules by translationally hot nascent $\mathrm{H_2}$ in cold interstellar gas.

title: Magnetic fields in extreme primordial halos: turbulent collapse and implications for early quasar formation
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in A&A
summary: It is sometimes suggested that the most massive quasars at high redshift may have formed from rare high-sigma peaks in the cosmic density field. We explore here the evolution in a massive primordial halo corresponding to one of these rare sigma peaks, employing cosmological high-resolution magneto-hydrodynamical zoom-in simulations with initial field strength of $10^{-14}-10^{-8}$ G. The dark matter halo forms at the intersection of strongly convergent flows, leading to the formation of highly supersonic turbulence already on intergalactic scales, with turbulent Mach numbers of order $10-20$ also within the halo. Turbulent magnetic field amplification has never been explored in this regime and we therefore investigate whether this gives rise to effects similar to those observed in more typical halos. While the weaker initial field is somewhat more strongly amplified as a result of the shear flows, overall the evolution in the different simulations is rather similar and the flows are dominated by supersonic turbulence. We show in particular that the turbulent Jeans mass always dominates over the thermal and magnetic Jeans masses, and only on scales of $10^{-2}-10$ pc, the magnetic Jeans mass may become comparable to the thermal one. Our simulations thus strongly suggest the evolution to be dominated by the large-scale dynamics. As established in previous work, we thus expect the formation of central massive objects of a few times $10^4$ M$_\odot$ also in the presence of magnetic fields. The situation is somewhat different from more typical atomic cooling halos, where previous results have indicated a larger relevance of the magnetic Jeans mass on intermediate scales, potentially enhancing the mass of the massive object.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 有时有人提出，高红移处质量最大的类星体可能形成于宇宙密度场中罕见的高σ峰。我们在此探索了一个对应于这些罕见σ峰之一的大质量原初暗物质晕中的演化，采用了具有初始场强为$10^{-14}-10^{-8}$ G的宇宙学高分辨率磁流体动力学zoom-in模拟。暗物质晕形成于强会聚流的交汇处，导致在星系际尺度上已经形成高度超音速湍流，且在晕内湍流马赫数约为10-20。湍流磁场放大从未在此区域被探索过，因此我们研究这是否会产生与更典型晕中观察到的类似效应。虽然较弱的初始场由于剪切流而得到稍强的放大，但总体而言，不同模拟中的演化相当相似，且流动由超音速湍流主导。我们特别表明，湍流金斯质量始终主导热金斯质量和磁金斯质量，仅在$10^{-2}-10$ pc尺度上，磁金斯质量可能变得与热金斯质量相当。因此，我们的模拟强烈表明演化由大尺度动力学主导。正如先前工作所确立的，我们预期即使在存在磁场的情况下，也会形成质量为数倍$10^4$ M$_\odot$的中心大质量天体。这种情况与更典型的原子冷却晕有所不同，在那些晕中，先前结果表明磁金斯质量在中间尺度上具有更大的相关性，可能增强大质量天体的质量。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于提供的AI结论（该结论基于可用摘要）：该极端环境下演化由大尺度动力学主导，即使存在磁场，仍预期形成约数倍10^4太阳质量的中心大质量天体；但与典型原子冷却晕不同，磁金斯质量在中间尺度上的重要性较小，不会显著增强中心天体质量。

From top to bottom the physical width was varied using 100, 10, 1 and 0.1 pc, and from left to right we varied the initial magnetic field strength to \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). figures.caption_zh: 图1：在四个不同空间尺度上沿y轴的密度加权密度投影。从上到下物理宽度分别变化为100、10、1和0.1 pc，从左到右初始磁场强度分别变化为\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\)和\(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有单位）。所有投影对应于最终演化阶段，即当晕达到峰值密度\(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)时。时间在每个面板左下角标出，磁场线从青色到品红色编码，表示场强增加。整体密度形态和特征性的四条冷流模式在大尺度上基本不受\(B_{0}\)影响。差异仅出现在较小尺度上，其中最强场情况发展出两个不同的核。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of density and temperature when reaching a peak density of \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Black, pink and purple lines are for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper), respectively. The density profile closely follows an isothermal collapse profile, while the temperature profile show the expected H 2 dominated cooling below \(10\) pc. This occurs for all three initial magnetic field strengths.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：当达到峰值密度\(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)时，质量加权的球对称分箱径向密度和温度剖面。黑色、粉色和紫色线分别对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\)和\(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟。密度剖面紧密遵循等温坍缩剖面，而温度剖面显示出预期的在\(10\) pc以下由H 2 主导的冷却。这发生在所有三种初始磁场强度下。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of radial velocity, turbulent velocity, sonic Mach number, turbulent Mach number, mass accretion rate for the halo when reaching three different peak densities. Black lines are for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G] (proper), pink lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G] (proper), and purple lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). Solid lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) , dashed lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) and dotted lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . The physical properties of the halo show no significant dependence on \(B_{0}\) , demonstrating that the collapse dynamics are dominated by the highly supersonic turbulence ( \(\mathcal{M}\sim 30-60\) ) driven by the converging cold streams.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：当达到三个不同峰值密度时，晕的径向速度、湍流速度、声速马赫数、湍流马赫数、质量吸积率的质量加权球对称分箱径向剖面。黑线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟，粉线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟，紫线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟。实线对应于\(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，虚线对应于\(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，点线对应于\(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)。晕的物理性质对\(B_{0}\)没有显著依赖性，表明坍缩动力学由会聚冷流驱动的高度超音速湍流（\(\mathcal{M}\sim 30-60\)）主导。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Density-weighted projections of the density along the x-axis with a physical width of \(0.02\) pc. From left to right we varied the initial magnetic field strength to \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). All projections correspond to the final evolutionary stage i.e. when the halo reaches a peak density of \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Times are indicated in the bottom left of each panel, and magnetic field lines are shown in magenta. Disc-like structures are present at sub-pc scales, with the strongest initial magnetic field case showing the clearest disc-like features. The morphology varies between the three simulations but is consistent with the dynamically subdominant role of the magnetic field, as the disc formation is not suppressed.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：物理宽度为\(0.02\) pc时沿x轴的密度加权密度投影。从左到右初始磁场强度分别变化为\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\)和\(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有单位）。所有投影对应于最终演化阶段，即当晕达到峰值密度\(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)时。时间在每个面板左下角标出，磁场线以品红色显示。在亚pc尺度上存在盘状结构，其中初始磁场最强的情况显示出最清晰的盘状特征。三种模拟之间的形态有所不同，但与磁场在动力学上处于次主导地位一致，因为盘的形成未被抑制。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of magnetic field strength, magnetic field amplification \(B/\rho^{2/3}\) and the magnetic-to-kinetic energy ratio \(E_{B}/E_{K}\) when reaching three different peak densities. Black lines are for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G] (proper), pink lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G] (proper), and purple lines for runs with \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). Solid lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) , dashed lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) and dotted lines correspond to \(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . The magnetic field is amplified beyond what is expected from pure spherical compression in all three simulations, though it never becomes dynamically relevant, with \(E_{B}/E_{K}\ll 1\) throughout the halo. All three cases converge to similar central field strengths of \(B\sim 10^{-2}\) G by the latest evolutionary stage.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：当达到三个不同峰值密度时，磁场强度、磁场放大\(B/\rho^{2/3}\)和磁能-动能比\(E_{B}/E_{K}\)的质量加权球对称分箱径向剖面。黑线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟，粉线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟，紫线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]（固有单位）的模拟。实线对应于\(\rho_{peak}=3\times 10^{-15}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，虚线对应于\(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-13}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)，点线对应于\(\rho_{peak}=1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)。在所有三种模拟中，磁场放大超出了纯球对称压缩的预期，但从未变得动力学相关，整个晕中\(E_{B}/E_{K}\ll 1\)。到最新演化阶段，三种情况都收敛到相似的中央场强\(B\sim 10^{-2}\) G。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Density-weighted projection of magnetic field magnitude along the y-axis at four different spatial scales. From top to bottom the physical width was varied using 100, 10, 1 and 0.1 pc, and from left to right we varied the initial magnetic field strength to \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) , \(10^{-10}\) and \(10^{-8}\) [G] (proper). All projections correspond to the final evolutionary stage i.e. when the halo reaches a peak density of \(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\) . Times are indicated in the bottom left of each panel, and magnetic field lines are shown in white. The magnetic field distribution closely follows the density structure at all spatial scales, with all three cases showing comparable field strengths in the central region. A diagonal structure is visible at \(100\) pc which may trace the interface between two of the converging cold flows.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：在四个不同空间尺度上沿y轴的磁场强度密度加权投影。从上到下物理宽度分别变化为100、10、1和0.1 pc，从左到右初始磁场强度分别变化为\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\)、\(10^{-10}\)和\(10^{-8}\) [G]（固有单位）。所有投影对应于最终演化阶段，即当晕达到峰值密度\(1\times 10^{-12}\) \({[g\,cm^{-3}]}\)时。时间在每个面板左下角标出，磁场线以白色显示。磁场分布在所有空间尺度上紧密跟随密度结构，三种情况在中心区域显示出相当的场强。在\(100\) pc处可见一个对角结构，可能追踪两个会聚冷流之间的界面。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Mass-weighted spherically binned radial profiles of magnetic Jeans mass (solid lines), thermal Jeans mass (dashed lines) and turbulent Jeans mass (dotted lines). Each panel represents different evolutionary stages of the halo that means that the peak density is varied. Colours follow the same convention as previous figures where black lines are for simulations with a proper initial magnetic field strength of \(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G], pink lines for simulations with \(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G], and purple lines for simulations with \(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]. The turbulent Jeans mass dominates over both thermal and magnetic contributions reaching \(\sim 10^{4}\) M ⊙ in the central regions. Magnetic pressure provides only a minor contribution in a limited radial range, confirming that the characteristic mass scale for collapse is set by turbulence rather than by magnetic fields.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：磁金斯质量（实线）、热金斯质量（虚线）和湍流金斯质量（点线）的质量加权球对称分箱径向剖面。每个面板代表晕的不同演化阶段，即峰值密度变化。颜色遵循与之前图形相同的约定，其中黑线对应于固有初始磁场强度为\(B_{0}=10^{-14}\) [G]的模拟，粉线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-10}\) [G]的模拟，紫线对应于\(B_{0}=10^{-8}\) [G]的模拟。湍流金斯质量主导热金斯质量和磁金斯质量，在中心区域达到\(\sim 10^{4}\) M ⊙。磁压力仅在有限的径向范围内提供次要贡献，证实坍缩的特征质量尺度由湍流而非磁场决定。

title: The CMZ Asymmetries: Feeding or Feedback?
summary: Three-fourths of the dense gas and dust in the CMZ is located at positive longitudes and positive radial velocities. The majority of compact 24 micrometer wavelength sources are at negative longitudes. These two asymmetries indicate either a recent asymmetric injection of gas along the bar dust lanes, or that most of the molecular gas is contained in a small number of massive, gravitationally bound clouds, or a major feedback episode which dissociated an entire sector of the CMZ's dense gas.
